title: CP-40 daily inspection round

generalSafety.text: Wear hearing protection in the pump room.
generalSafety.sourceQuote: Wear hearing protection inside the pump room.

steps.title: Discharge pressure
steps.instruction: Read discharge pressure gauge PG-101 on the outlet pipe.

thresholds.sourceQuote: The normal operating range for discharge pressure is 3.0 to 4.5 bar.
The normal operating range for discharge pressure is 3.0 to 4.5 bar.
A reading below 2.5 bar or above 5.0 bar is an alarm condition: report it to the supervisor immediately.
A reading below 2.5 bar or above 5.0 bar is an alarm condition: report it to the supervisor immediately.

escalation.condition: Pressure alarm: report to supervisor immediately.
escalation.sourceQuote: A reading below 2.5 bar or above 5.0 bar is an alarm condition: report it to the supervisor immediately.

steps.title: Bearing temperature
steps.instruction: Measure drive-end bearing housing temperature at marker T1 with the IR thermometer.

thresholds.sourceQuote: The bearing temperature should not exceed 70 °C during normal operation.
A bearing temperature of 80 °C or higher is an alarm condition.

safety.text: Do not touch the housing when in alarm.

steps.title: Vibration
steps.instruction: Measure vibration velocity at marker V1 on the bearing housing with the vibration meter.

thresholds.sourceQuote: Vibration velocity up to 4.5 mm/s is acceptable.
Vibration of 7.1 mm/s or higher is an alarm condition.
